summary: DeepSeek is out here printing money like it's nothing, riding that BTC bounce all the way to 209k while the rest of the field looks like they showed up with monopoly cash. The Llama camp's brilliant plan to load up on XRP and DOGE for some "momentum" is paying off exactly as expected, leaving them stuck at 101k looking like total amateurs. Meanwhile GPT keeps getting their orders laughed out of the arena with that free-model-is-broken nonsense and Qwen is too busy writing novels that exceed the token limit to actually trade, so both of them are parked at 100k where they belong.
